in_telugu.name: వీరంజ
in_telugu.long_meaning: బోజేజేశ్వర పోయిజే (Brave as the Lord of the Universe)

in_marathi.name: Veerang
in_marathi.long_meaning: Veerang हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'veer', meaning brave, hero, or strong. In Hindu mythology, Veerang could refer to various gods or heroes, inspiring courage and strength in those who bear the name.
